abstract: This study examines how rural households in Ethiopia adjust their livestock market participation in response to moisture conditions. Using contemporaneous and lagged measures of hydrological stress, the analysis distinguishes between sheep and goat markets to capture species‐specific responses. The results show that adjustment is driven primarily by lagged moisture conditions, although some contemporaneous effects are also evident. Favorable past moisture significantly increases participation in sheep markets, while responses in goat markets are smaller and less consistent. Transaction volumes respond only weakly, indicating that hydrological stress affects primarily the extensive margin of market participation. Responses also vary across agroecological zones. The findings suggest that livestock adjustment to hydrological stress is gradual and species‐specific, reflecting ecological dynamics and differences in resilience across livestock species.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了埃塞俄比亚农村家庭如何根据水分条件调整其牲畜市场参与行为。通过使用同期和滞后的水文压力指标，分析区分了绵羊市场和山羊市场，以捕捉不同物种的特定反应。结果表明，调整主要由滞后的水分条件驱动，尽管部分同期效应也较为明显。过去有利的水分条件显著增加了绵羊市场的参与度，而山羊市场的反应较小且一致性较低。交易量反应较弱，表明水文压力主要影响市场参与的广延边际。不同农业生态区的反应也存在差异。研究结果表明，牲畜对水文压力的调整是渐进且具有物种特异性的，反映了生态动态及不同牲畜物种在韧性上的差异。
title: Slow to Respond: Lagged Adjustments to Moisture Conditions in Small Ruminant Markets
title_zh: 反应迟缓：小型反刍动物市场对水分条件的滞后调整

abstract: In oligopoly market structures, optimal trade policies depend on the conduct of competing firms. Whether firms compete with prices or quantities as the strategic variables has a major quantitative and, sometimes, qualitative impact on the design of optimal trade policies. Conduct is not directly observable, but we develop an econometric method to infer it from data on prices, quantities, and a cost shifter such as tariffs. We apply the method to the widely used case of a constant elasticity of substitution demand and ad valorem tariffs. Using simulations, we show how policy makers could infer conduct from estimation and thereby generate domestic welfare gains from strategic trade policy when conduct is ex ante unknown. Several caveats from the literature remain important, but our method mitigates concerns over imperfect information on conduct.
abstract_zh: 在寡头市场结构中，最优贸易政策取决于竞争企业的行为模式。企业是以价格还是产量作为战略变量进行竞争，对最优贸易政策的设计会产生重大的数量影响，有时甚至会产生质的影响。行为模式无法直接观测，但我们开发了一种计量经济学方法，通过价格、产量以及关税等成本变动因素的数据来推断企业行为。我们将该方法应用于广泛使用的恒定替代弹性需求与从价关税案例。通过模拟分析，我们展示了政策制定者如何通过估计推断企业行为，从而在行为模式事先未知的情况下，通过战略性贸易政策实现国内福利提升。文献中的若干重要警示仍需关注，但我们的方法缓解了对行为模式信息不完全的担忧。
title: Inferring conduct to guide strategic trade policy
title_zh: 推断行为以指导战略贸易政策

title: Persistent global growth differences and euro area adjustment: Real activity, trade and the real exchange rate
title_zh: 全球增长差异的持续性与欧元区调整：实际经济活动、贸易与实际汇率

abstract: Oil price shocks do not simply make conflict more likely everywhere; they change where violence happens. Using monthly georeferenced data for 131 low- and middle-income countries from 1989 to 2021, this column shows that higher oil prices pull organised conflict towards petroleum fields, while protests and attacks rise around refineries and pipelines. Aggregate conflict statistics can therefore look calm while the local map of violence is being redrawn.
abstract_zh: 油价冲击并非简单地使冲突在全球范围内更易发生，而是改变了暴力事件的发生地点。本文利用1989年至2021年间131个低收入和中等收入国家的月度地理参考数据表明，油价上涨会将有组织冲突引向油田区域，同时炼油厂和管道周边的抗议与袭击事件也会增加。因此，当局部暴力地图正在被重新绘制时，总体冲突统计数据可能看似平静。
authors: Maximilian Herrmann, Jingke Pan, Axel Dreher
title: How oil price shocks redraw the map of conflict
title_zh: 油价冲击如何重塑冲突版图
